reviews.name: Sarah M.
reviews.body: My roof was leaking badly after that last storm. Summit Roofing came out the same day, gave me a clear quote, and got it fixed fast. Lifesavers!

reviews.name: David L.
reviews.body: Needed a full roof replacement. They worked quickly, kept the site clean, and the new roof looks fantastic. Very impressed with their speed.

reviews.body: Had them inspect after a hailstorm. They were honest about what needed doing and didn't push for unnecessary work. The free inspection was a huge help.
